svg.text: D. Radial concentration profiles through the five layers
BTCS, 1600 °C, kernel-only start; concentration over the initial kernel concentration; shaded bands are the layers

Concentrations at or below 1e-12 of the initial value are not drawn (log scale; the outer node is zero by the absorbing boundary). The profile at the node closest to each requested time is shown; values are the

numerical solution of the stated model. Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit 85ea748; registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients

chosen by the strato-data selection function (register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start; constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a
numerical comparison, not an experimental validation.
